verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents personal API tokens (pk_) and an OAuth2 flow that gives each user their own token. Nothing in the evidence says these credentials can be limited by scope, permission, or resource for least-privilege agent access. Issuing credentials is related to this story but is not scoped credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
